description: This file provides a no-operation implementation of the OpenTelemetry trace API, including types and functions for tracers, spans, and tracer providers that do not record telemetry.

classes.name: TracerProvider
classes.description: A no-op implementation of the OpenTelemetry TracerProvider.

classes.name: Tracer
classes.description: A no-op implementation of the OpenTelemetry Tracer.

classes.name: Span
classes.description: A no-op implementation of the OpenTelemetry Span.

methods.name: NewTracerProvider
methods.description: Returns a no-op TracerProvider that does not record telemetry.

methods.name: Tracer.Start
methods.description: Creates a no-op span, setting it in the context.

methods.name: Span.IsRecording
methods.description: Always returns false, indicating the span does not record.

methods.name: Span.SetStatus
methods.description: No-op method to set span status.

methods.name: Span.SetAttributes
methods.description: No-op method to set span attributes.

methods.name: Span.End
methods.description: No-op method to end the span.

methods.name: Span.RecordError
methods.description: No-op method to record an error.

methods.name: Span.AddEvent
methods.description: No-op method to add an event.

methods.name: Span.AddLink
methods.description: No-op method to add a link.

methods.name: Span.SetName
methods.description: No-op method to set the span's name.
